status: exploratory development experiment; not a new final test
question: Does selecting an otherwise unchanged gate by mean per-condition tuning AUROC reduce its loss relative to average and fixed fusion?
intervention: Select the checkpoint with largest mean tuning AUROC across clean/jpeg70/resize05, with earliest checkpoint for ties within 1e-6 and epoch 0 included.
controls: Replay the original BCE optimization, optimizer, initialization and BCE patience stopping without changes; reproduce original BCE-selected checkpoint before interpreting the intervention.
data: Only artifacts/round8_a/seedN/arm/bundle.json and their original completion/settings files. Tuning uses the original saved tuning partition. All source image views of one identity remain in the existing partition.
evaluation: Report every ADM/BigGAN development condition and every data seed. Average gate initialization metrics within each data seed. Compare against both average and selected fixed fusion, and compare quality_gate against score_gate.
selection_policy: No method, checkpoint or parameter selection using development results. No further search in this experiment.
primary_descriptive_summary: Equal mean of the eight ADM/BigGAN by clean/jpeg70/jpeg50/resize05 AUROCs, plus all cells and seed-level differences; no significance claim.
exclusions: Do not open any Round 7 reserved-test or Round 8 final-test manifest, predictions, images or scores.
limitations: ADM/BigGAN development has been inspected before; the three data seeds reuse pools. Source tuning is SD15 only. Any improvement is exploratory and requires independent confirmation.
